name: Cash Account Type 4 Code
definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the cash account.

CASH.name: Cash Payment
CASH.definition: Account used for the payment of cash.

CHAR.name: Charges
CHAR.definition: Account used for charges if different from the account for payment.

COMM.name: Commission
COMM.definition: Account used for commission if different from the account for payment.

TAXE.name: Tax
TAXE.definition: Account used for taxes if different from the account for payment.

CISH.name: Cash Income
CISH.definition: Account used for payment of income if different from the current cash account.

TRAS.name: Cash Trading
TRAS.definition: Account used for trading if different from the current cash account.

SACC.name: Settlement
SACC.definition: Account used to post debit and credit entries, as a result of transactions cleared and settled through a specific clearing and settlement system.

CACC.name: Current
CACC.definition: Account used to post debits and credits when no specific account has been nominated.

MGLD.name: Marginal Lending
MGLD.definition: Account used for a marginal lending facility.

MOMA.name: Money Market
MOMA.definition: Account used for money markets if different from the cash account.
